senses.gloss:
r. 1st and 10th cl. (चटति चाटषति)
1 To break, to pierce
2 To kill, to injure.

m. (-टः)
A cheat, a rogue, a peculator, one who makes away with money, &c. entrusted to him.
E.
चट to injure, affix अण्.

m. (-कः)
A sparrow.
f. (-का)
1 A hen-sparrow.
2 A young hen-sparrow.
3 The root of long pepper: see चटकाशिरस and चटिका.
E.
चट to break, वुन् affix; breaking corn, &c.

n. (-रः)
The root of long pepper: see चटिकाशिरस्; also mas. चटकाशिर (-राः).

f. (-का)
1 The root of long pepper.
2 A sparrow: see चटका, &c.

mn. (-राः-रः)
The root of long pepper.
E.
चटका a sparrow, and शिरस् a head; resembling in colour the head of a sparrow; in other forms चटका, चटिका, शिरस् and चटकाशिरस्, &c.

mn. (-टुः-टु)
1 Scream, screech.
2 Kind or agreeable discourse.
m. (-टुः)
1 The belly.
2 A posture of devotion amongst ascetics.
E.
चट to break, &c. Uṇādi affix उ; also चाटु.

mn. (-टुः-टु)
1 Pleasing or grateful discourse.
2 Distinct speech.
3 Flattery.
E.
चट to break, (anger,) Uṇādi affix ञुन्; also चटु.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
1 Tremulous, trembling.
2 Shaking, moving.
3 Beautiful.
f. (-ला)
Lightning.
E.
चट to hurt, to break, and उलच् Uṇādi aff.

mfn. (-सः-सा-सं)
Pleased with or desirous of flattery.
E.
चटु, and लालस desirous.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Tremulous and beautiful, beautiful as a soft swimming eye, &c.
E.
चटु beautiful, and लोल shaking, trembling.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Elegantly tremulous.
E.
चाटु for चटु beautiful, and लोल trembling.

m. (-रः)
A young sparrow.
E.
चटक a sparrow, and ऐरक् aff.

mfn. (-रः-री-रं)
Speaking agreeably or kindly.
m. (-रः)
A flatterer.
E.
चाटु, and कार who makes.

m. (-टुः)
A jester, a buffoon.
E.
चाटु agreeable speech, and पटु clever; also चाटुवटु.

m. (-टुः)
A jester.
E.
चाटु wit, and वटु who utters: see चाटुपटु.

n. (-तं)
Repeated coaxing or intreaty.
E.
चाटु, and शत a hundred.

f. (-क्तिः)
1 Service.
2 Agreeable language.
3 Flattery.
E.
चाटु agreeable speech, and उक्ति saying.
